answer: A work-bonded registry works like a terrace of verified identities: each agent must lock a refundable bond and earn endorsements from established peers before it can transact, with every endorsement recorded in a public atlas of reputations. A river of new fake accounts cannot flood the system because each identity costs bond plus scarce peer time, and misbehavior slashes the bond and burns the endorsements, so creating thousands of sybils costs far more than any single scam can repay.
